question: Does approximately six years of Binance Spot BTC/ETH/SOL 4h history provide materially more dependence-aware formal support for an ETH/SOL leadership study under calendar-equivalent 0048 semantics, or does 4h mainly multiply highly correlated rows?
hypothesis: Four-hour bars may increase state-resolution and raw row counts, but they solve the 0048 support constraint only if the strict calendar-equivalent pipeline retains at least 12 complete 336-eligible-row dependence blocks after 1440-bar feature history, BTC-uptrend eligibility, 2190 matured training-origin support, 2190 matured shadow-origin support and 336-bar target maturity.
economic_mechanism: Intraday ETH/SOL leadership information may form at sub-daily frequency, but smaller bars are not automatically more independent evidence. 0053 separates genuine time-support improvement from raw-row multiplication before any new predictive model is allowed.
stopping_rule: After this preregistration is merged, capture the exact frozen Binance Spot 4h dataset once under DATA_RETRIEVAL_CONTRACT.json, hash-freeze the successful payload, then implement one deterministic label-blind support-funnel counter and execute exactly one feasibility measurement. No ETH/SOL winner labels, model fits, calibration fits, predictive scores or portfolio economics may be computed under 0053. The Track-A classification closes 0053; Tracks B/C are diagnostics only and cannot rescue Track A.
success_criteria: Data integrity and common 4h coverage are reproducibly hash-frozen with no synthetic fill or alternate venue substitution.
Primary Track A has at least 12 complete 336-ordered-eligible-formal-row dependence blocks after all frozen support clocks.
The measurement remains label-blind and performs zero predictive model/calibration fit.
Canonical BRRK, Phase 6, signing, order submission and production authority remain unchanged.
failure_criteria: Track A with fewer than 12 complete 336-row blocks produces FAIL_4H_DOES_NOT_SOLVE_0048_SUPPORT_CONSTRAINT.
Unfreezable, materially incomplete or non-contiguous common 4h history produces DATA_INTEGRITY_INCONCLUSIVE.
Any ETH/SOL outcome-label, predictive-model, calibration, AUC/NLL/Brier, confidence-threshold or portfolio computation invalidates the 0053 execution rather than becoming a 0053 result.
allowed_followup: Only PASS_4H_CALENDAR_EQUIVALENT_SUPPORT_FEASIBLE may motivate a separately preregistered 4h predictive-leadership research ID under the same calendar-equivalent support semantics.
If Track A fails but Track C shows adequate support, Track C may motivate a different new methodology research ID with separate statistical justification; it has no automatic predictive authority.
Future genuinely unseen data may be studied only under a separately registered protocol.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID reduction of Track-A 2190 training support, 2190 shadow support, 336-row dependence block or 12-block threshold after counts are observed.
No same-ID switch to 1h, 2h, 6h, 8h, 12h, futures data or alternate venue.
No ETH/SOL winner labels, realized margins, model coefficients, calibration gamma, NLL, Brier, AUC, confidence breakpoint, bootstrap predictive superiority or portfolio economics under 0053.
No 0048 rerun/rescue and no direct 0049 concentration authority.
No canonical BRRK modification, Phase 6 modification, leverage expansion, signing, order submission or production authorization.

0053 is result-informed by the immutable 0048 closeout at main SHA 62c0e2a4e1fb3ddfdc64c41adbd06b03012df895 and does not alter or rerun 0048.

Calendar-equivalent feature horizons are 120/360/720/1440 4h bars for 20/60/120/240 days; maximum feature history is 1440 bars.

Track A is primary: 2190 eligible matured training origins, 2190 matured eligible shadow origins, 336-row dependence block, 12 complete blocks required.
